reason: THREAT-gate's one open finding: a pull request from a fork brings its own tower-gate.yml into the pull request and merge-group runs, so a required check bound to the GitHub Actions app can be made green by that workflow; nothing inside the repository can refuse it. The barrier is that only a writer queues a merge, under D-344's rule that a session never queues a fork's pull request whose diff touches .github/. A push rule cannot close it: GitHub refused the ruleset (POST /rulesets, target push, file_path_restriction .github/workflows/**) with 422 "Source public repos cannot have push rules" (the Torre, 2026-11-19), so a public repository has no such barrier. Ends when the required tower/gate status is bound to a GitHub App whose key lives outside any workflow (the AWS port posts it), so a fork's workflow cannot post as it. Revoked by D-360 (Torre por delegação do Daniel 22/11/2026): session-granted under D-325 without independent approval; THREAT-gate stays open until fixed technically.
